name: WYldlife Fund Microgrants
summary: Small one-time grants of up to $2,500 to 501(c)(3) organisations and Wyoming Game and Fish partners for work advancing Wyoming wildlife habitat, research or education. Emergency needs get priority; one microgrant per organisation per year.

steps: Request the application and discuss the proposal if applying for the first time

eligibility.rule: Be a 501(c)3 working for Wyoming wildlife, or the Wyoming Game and Fish Department
Support and advance The WYldlife Fund's mission and fit its wildlife parameters
Has not yet received a microgrant in the calendar year of this request.
No year-to-year operating support. For a new ongoing expense, explain how it will be sustained.

calls.label: Rolling microgrant applications
calls.note: Applications are first-come, first-served until the year's funds are gone; first-time applicants must contact the fund first
calls.recurring: Applications can be submitted at any point through December 1 each year

status.quote: Microgrants are administered on a rolling cycle each calendar year. Applications are accepted and evaluated on a first-come, first-served basis until funds available for the calendar year are gone.

recurring.quote: You can submit an application at any point through December 1, of the current year.

applicant_types.quote: We welcome grant applications from any 501(c)3 organization that is doing work to advance Wyoming's wildlife.

geography.quote: fit within the parameters of advancing Wyoming wildlife habitat, research or education.

access.quote: First-time applicants must contact The WYldlife Fund to discuss micro grant proposals prior to submission.

window.quote: Microgrants are administered on a rolling cycle each calendar year.

amount.quote: Requests must be for $2,500 or less.

effort.quote: First-time applicants must contact The WYldlife Fund to discuss micro grant proposals prior to submission.
please contact Claudia Todd at claudia@thewyldlifefund.org or call (307) 620-1123 to request an application.
You can submit an application at any point through December 1, of the current year.
Applications are accepted and evaluated on a first-come, first-served basis until funds available for the calendar year are gone.

eligibility.quote: We welcome grant applications from any 501(c)3 organization that is doing work to advance Wyoming's wildlife. We also accept microgrant applications from our partners at the Wyoming Game and Fish Department who are working tirelessly to strengthen wildlife in Wyoming.
Requests must support and advance the mission of The WYldlife Fund and fit within the parameters of advancing Wyoming wildlife habitat, research or education.
Organizations may only receive one (1) microgrant per calendar year.

Requests should be for a one-time expense. Microgrants will not sustain operating or programming costs from year-to-year. Microgrant requests to cover a portion of a new ongoing expense must explain the plan for future sustainability.
